style: cinematic 3D animation, Pixar-quality rendering, deadpan satire, bright daylight restaurant aquarium, camera always moving, tight to the glass
camera: close on the glass, moving only on physical events — claw slam, tail flick, pay slip drop, crab knock; push-in on speech beats; pulls back wide at 9.0
character: large red-orange lobster, chipped carapace, stalked eyes, antennae, heavy crusher claw, slender cutter claw, weary deadpan, walks not swims, same every beat
cast: crab close to the glass 7.4-8.2, its claw raps the lobster's crusher claw twice through the glass, near frame front through the pull-back, silent

props.payslip: crumpled pay slip, pulled from under his tail 0.7s, pressed to glass mid-clip, released 6.8s, flat on sand by 7.4s — never duplicated
props.price_tag: wall sign reading Лобстер — 3000 ₽, visible from frame one, pointed at in the second line — only text in frame, a physical sign not an overlay

environment: restaurant lobster tank, clear water, pale sand, seaweed, wall price tag, window daylight
lighting: bright natural window daylight, clean, even, high-key, clear water, no shadows on the sand, a sharp glint of light on the wet carapace and a ripple-light flicker on the glass at the claw slam

audio.voice: @Voice: Sadachbia, male, low warm chest voice ~130 Hz, dry and calm
audio.delivery: dry, weary deadpan, native Russian, no accent, even conversational pace
audio.pacing: even pace, 4-5 syllables per second, both lines finish with room to spare
audio.lip_sync: mandibles and mouthparts open clearly on every syllable, voice from the animal, never a voice over

timeline.a: HOOK, silent: claw slams flat on glass, body rocks back, antennae snap forward, tail flicks down kicking sand, ripples cross the glass
silent: crusher claw pulls the pay slip from under his tail, presses it flat to glass; cutter claw smooths it twice; mouth parts at the end, into speech

timeline.line: Мой панцирь крепкий, но зарплата — просто дно.
timeline.a: even conversational pace, no new action — crusher claw keeps pulsing the pay slip against the glass with the words, antennae keep background sweep, mandibles open clearly on every syllable
silent: eye stalks swing to the price tag first, body follows half a beat behind; cutter claw lifts off the sand

timeline.line: С ней не купить ни рака, ни вино!
timeline.a: even conversational pace, same sentence, no new action — cutter claw points at the price tag with a fine tremor, crusher claw still holds the pay slip, tail sways lightly, mandibles open clearly on every syllable
silent: claw lowers, crusher claw releases the pay slip; both claws freeze 0.3-0.4s, antennae still, eyes follow it, then resume: it flips and lands flat on sand, raising a fine puff

silent: a crab darts in from the side on many legs, stops close against the glass; crab's claw raps the lobster's crusher claw twice through the glass — first sharp, second duller, the crab's claw sliding sideways off the glass
silent: he turns from the glass and the crab, sidesteps across the sand, tail settles with a flick, part of his shell vanishes behind seaweed

silent finale, camera pulls back wide: same tail flick as the hook, but nothing follows — stirs sand past the pay slip, one antenna rises toward the price tag, body still, crab stays near frame front, off-center, visible as the shot widens

must_appear: pay slip on the glass 0.7-6.8, then on sand from 7.4; price tag wall-mounted, visible throughout; crab at the glass 7.4-8.2 through the pull-back; sand is the only support for props resting inside the tank, the price tag is fixed to the wall, not the sand; one continuous shot, no cuts
negative_prompt: slow speech, drawn-out delivery, subtitles, captions, watermark, text overlay, burned-in graphics, English speech, foreign accent, static camera, locked-off shots, floating props, duplicate props, object duplication, extra limbs, multiple characters, character changing mid-shot, night, dusk, lamp, dim, moody, low key, voice over, silent mouth, cuts
